additional_metadata_only_prs.head: 71632fa389ae93824b2f42d265278a9bd0f6de59
additional_metadata_only_prs.title: fix(web): bind receipt archival to exact signed receipt identity (GP-BUG-01)
additional_metadata_only_prs.body:
## GP-BUG-01: receipt archive state belongs to the signed receipt

Source: audit [#312](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/GhostPay/pull/312), COMP-OPEN-01. When a seller archives receipt A, invalidates the invoice binding, and signs a distinct receipt B, A's completed or delayed archive status can incorrectly disable B's Archive button.

### Test-first focused change
- Two committed Vitest component regressions verify distinct valid signatures, A/B archive writer arguments, reset after completed A, and late A completion after B is signed.
- The production change advances archive completion generation on invoice invalidation, new validation and new signature creation. In-flight writes finish against their original immutable receipt and cannot mark a newer one archived.
- Serializes archive writes within a mounted panel until the earlier write settles, avoiding concurrent writes to the same encrypted vault. No new dependencies, protocol changes, hosted services, contract edits, or export authority changes.

### Source and gates
- Main base: `aa3df1cb37274fae73af0ca957183c15c51b62d3`.
- Claim: `98d157d1`; tests: `8a37cf86` then `4e5ac927`; product: `8e8dbede`; handoff: `71632fa3`.
- **Not merge-qualified**. Tests were authored but **not executed locally**, because GitHub DNS prevented repository checkout. Exact-head hosted Vitest/typecheck/lint/browser CI and an independent verifier are required. Do not claim green CI from previous source heads.
- The current broad [#307](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/GhostPay/pull/307) already changes `ReceiptPanel.tsx` for print output; its source and QA must be preserved when selectively integrating this isolated repair. Do not wholesale replace its version.
- The integration lock was read as released generation 8; this isolated change did not acquire it, merge to main, trigger a deployment or clear unresolved Mythril findings.
- Source-pinned [handoff](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/GhostPay/blob/automation/20261120T1840Z/bug/receipt-archive-identity/docs/handoffs/RECEIPT_ARCHIVE_IDENTITY_20261120.md).
additional_metadata_only_prs.scope: Metadata-only inspection; no code review, qualification, owner takeover or write.
